options.unknownStrategy: The imported address strategy is outside the supported choices. Review it in JSON.
options.malformedHosts: This server uses an unsupported format for its static records. Review them in JSON.
options.title: Advanced: IPv6 and static records
options.familyHelp: For name lookups, the core requests both families or just the selected one. A preference orders the resulting addresses. Individual queries and rules can override this default.
options.hostsHelp: When a query reaches this server, these addresses take precedence over entries from hosts files.
options.noHosts: Static records need a hosts DNS server. Set one up in Editor and choose which queries it serves.
options.ambiguous: This configuration contains matching server names or equivalent domain names. Resolve the conflict in JSON.
options.addressHelp: Enter one or more IPv4 or IPv6 addresses separated by commas or spaces.
options.duplicate: This server already has an entry for that domain.

invalid.domain: Enter a domain name, such as printer.home.arpa.
invalid.addresses: Enter one or more valid IPv4 or IPv6 addresses.

dns.noPaths: No supported outbounds for DNS assignment in this configuration.
dns.scopeNote: Each choice sets DNS for the domains listed under that outbound. Other domains keep their DNS settings.
dns.addHint: Enter an IPv4 address for DNS over TCP. The connection setting controls how the router reaches this server.

reason.core: DNS editing is unavailable for this core version.
reason.draft: Simple cannot safely edit DNS in this configuration. Review the settings in Editor or JSON.
reason.firstServer: The core uses its first DNS server by default. To set that default, add the first server in Editor.
reason.address: Enter the IPv4 address of the DNS server.
reason.detour: Choose a supported outbound from the current draft.
reason.scope: This outbound has no domain scope that Simple can safely edit.
reason.conflict: Existing rules can change which domains match. Review their order and conditions in Editor.
reason.resolver: No suitable DNS server for this outbound. Add a server with a matching connection.
reason.stale: The configuration changed. Review the current draft before editing DNS.
reason.bootstrap: The current server may also resolve hostnames for other connections. Set a hostname resolver in Editor before adding a second server.

dns.replaceAssignments: The listed domains have different DNS settings. Choosing a server replaces the assignment for all of them.

fallback.title: Backup servers
fallback.absent: There is no fallback chain in this configuration. Configure one in Editor to use backup servers.
fallback.sequential: The core tries the next server after a timeout, a connection error or a DNS failure. A successful reply, even an empty one, or a reply that the domain does not exist ends the search.
fallback.strategy: This chain uses the {{strategy}} strategy. Simple can edit only sequential chains.
fallback.members: This chain has missing, repeated or forward-referenced servers. Review its members in Editor.
fallback.empty: No backup servers in this chain.
fallback.noChoices: All available servers are in this chain. The core can use only servers listed before the chain in the inventory.
